info.name: Flowexa Mobile API
info.description:
REST API for the Flowexa mobile app (`unichat_mobile_app`).

Base URL: `https://api.teamzo.io/api/v1`

## Auth
1. Run **Auth · Device Login → POST device-auth/check** with a PIN or QR `token` from the web app (Settings → Devices → Link a device).
2. Run **POST device-auth/claim** — its test script saves `{{token}}` automatically.
3. Or use **Auth → POST auth/login** with email + password.

All other requests send `Authorization: Bearer {{token}}` via collection auth.

Generated from `php artisan route:list` — methods/paths are exact; request bodies for unlisted fields are placeholders, check the FormRequest.
